text: DSH Sidebar Scroll（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：让侧栏导航、项目与会话列表共用滚动空间。它通过 bundle 替换官方侧栏，并注册自定义侧栏界面及面板导航。主要功能包括导航与工作区列表间的滚轮接力、面板切换和固定管理，以及保留新建会话、设置和底部操作入口。适合希望在 DSH 中为项目与会话列表腾出更多可滚动空间的用户。插件代码未要求 API 密钥或外部账号。

DSH Sidebar Scroll replaces the DSH Web sidebar with a custom shell. It shares scrolling between navigation and workspace lists, supports panel selection and pinning, and retains session, settings, and footer controls. No API key or external account is required.
想让 DSH 左侧菜单和项目列表一起滚动。
项目和会话太多时，怎么给 DSH 侧栏列表腾出空间？
让滚轮先移走侧栏导航，再继续滚动工作区列表。
我希望 DSH 侧边栏能切换面板并固定常用入口。
Can the DSH sidebar navigation and workspace list share one scroll area?
I want wheel scrolling to continue smoothly from sidebar navigation into projects.
DSH Sidebar Scroll 的功能「共用滚动与滚轮接力」：侧栏导航和工作区列表位于同一滚动区域；滚轮向下可先滚走导航，再把剩余距离交给项目列表，向上则反向接力。
DSH Sidebar Scroll 的功能「面板导航与固定入口」：侧栏根据已注册面板显示导航行，支持选择面板，并通过“更多”菜单管理面板固定状态。
DSH Sidebar Scroll: the sidebar keeps session creation, collapse, settings, and footer controls connected to DSH.
DSH Sidebar Scroll 使用前须知：侧栏面板点击会在宿主提供 analytics 服务时记录菜单类别与位置事件。

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · DSH Sidebar Scroll：[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Scroll sidebar navigation, projects, and conversations together in DeepSeek Harness. As you scroll down, navigation moves out of view and gives projects and conversations more room. The brand, New Session button, and account footer stay fixed.

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · Install：The current release targets **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1**. For DSH 0.2.1-rc.3, use plugin tag `v0.1.1`.

In the DSH plugin manager, install this Git source:

```text
github:Rakanrkk/dsh-sidebar-scroll#main
```

For a CLI-managed Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:Rakanrkk/dsh-sidebar-scroll#main'
```

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · Install：For DSH Desktop, use its own plugin manager so the plugin is installed into the desktop profile. Refresh the interface after installation. Built client files are included; installation does not need a build step.

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · Behavior：- Projects lists grow with their content and share the navigation's scroll viewport.
- Workspace browsers that bind DSH's section scroller keep its scroll handoff: navigation moves away before the list scrolls. Older workspace builds that do not bind it retain outer scrolling and an outer scrollbar.
- Scrolling dismisses Projects conversation menus.
- Panel icons and pinning, narrow-screen drawers, keyboard focus, and session-creation permissions follow the current official sidebar.

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · Behavior：Projects integration uses the `.pj-root` and `.pj-list` selectors from Projects 1.0.0-local.1. Versions that change those selectors need separate compatibility checks.

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · Disable or remove：Deactivate or remove the **DSH Sidebar Scroll bundle** in the plugin manager, then refresh the interface. Restart the DSH process if the manager requires it. This removes its composition patch and restores the official sidebar. Disabling only the `sidebar-scroll` runtime entry leaves the bundle patch active and can leave the sidebar empty; re-enable that entry or deactivate the whole bundle to recover.

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · Disable or remove：The bundle replaces the `ui-sidebar` presentation row while enabled. Use one sidebar-shell replacement at a time. Check compatibility before upgrading DSH: this release includes the matching sidebar component and intentionally targets one host version.

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · Development：Use Node.js 24.9.0 or later:

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
npm run check
```

`lib/client.js` is committed so Git installations can use the built client directly. CI checks that rebuilding produces the same client file.

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · Development：To check the installed Desktop runtime offline, run `npm run check:host`. On Windows it locates the usual per-user installation; for another location, use `npm run check:host -- --asar /path/to/app.asar`. This loads the installed renderer, shared client modules, and official workspace component in a DOM test environment without changing a profile. It reports whether the actual workspace consumes the section-scroller hook or uses the outer-scroll fallback.

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · Development：`npm run check:browser` checks scrolling and layout in an existing Chromium installation; set `CHROME_PATH` to select one. With an installed host it uses the plugin bundle and host workspace CSS; without one it uses the actual CSS and handoff source with layout fixtures. These checks cover legacy, bound-scroller, and Projects-shaped lists. CI requires Chromium with `DSH_REQUIRE_BROWSER=1`; actual Projects business actions and GUI lifecycle remain separate integration checks.

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · Release：Pushing a `vX.Y.Z` tag matching the package version reuses CI to check the build, tests, release metadata, and installation of the packed artifact through [dsh-plugin-checker](https://github.com/bowenliang123/dsh-plugin-checker) with the declared DSH version. The same artifact is then published to GitHub Releases and npm. Run the Release workflow manually with an existing tag to retry; an existing npm version must have the same integrity as the artifact.

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · Release：npm uses [Trusted Publishing](https://docs.npmjs.com/trusted-publishers/) by default. For the first publication, use an npm account that owns the `@rakan` scope and configure the repository secret `NPM_TOKEN` with permission to create this package; this still publishes the artifact verified by CI. After creating the package, configure its GitHub Actions trusted publisher: owner `Rakanrkk`, repository `dsh-sidebar-scroll`, workflow `release.yml`, no environment, and allow direct `npm publish`. Remove `NPM_TOKEN` to use OIDC and complete the first successful publication within two days of creating the configuration. GitHub Releases can publish independently while npm account setup is incomplete; the npm job reports failure.

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · Release：Each release includes the versioned package and an identical `dsh-sidebar-scroll.tgz` asset. Existing assets are verified by SHA-256 and never overwritten. The community download URL uses `releases/latest/download/dsh-sidebar-scroll.tgz`, so normal stable releases update the download without a catalog PR. Prereleases do not change the stable catalog entry.

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · Release：The community website entry lives in [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/blob/main/data/plugins/Rakanrkk__dsh-sidebar-scroll.yml). Run `node scripts/update-market.mjs` to check its download and description, or add `--submit` to submit changes using the authenticated GitHub CLI. An unchanged entry creates no PR; a pending update PR is reused. A change to functionality or supported DSH versions can require an entry update. Set `MARKET_TOKEN` with permission to write to your fork and open an upstream PR to automate submission; otherwise, download the generated draft.

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · Release：Installed-plugin update checks are separate from catalog edits: dsh-market checks npm versions or the chosen GitHub source. An explicitly pinned tag or tarball remains pinned. npm publication is optional for the community website; the community's format-1 DSH discovery index currently requires npm metadata and its subsequent probe and build.

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · License and upstream：MIT. Sidebar rendering is adapted from [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), package `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar`, version 0.2.2-rc.1, at [fcc0ad4](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/commit/fcc0ad462172522aaf5c93a7b2e01f6b9f0b0159). The upstream copyright is preserved in [LICENSE](LICENSE). Bundled dependency notices are included in [THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt).

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · DSH 侧栏共用滚动：[English](README.md)

让 DeepSeek Harness 左侧的功能菜单、项目和会话列表一起滚动。向下滚动时，上方功能菜单移出视野，项目和会话便能使用更多空间；品牌、新会话按钮和底部账户栏保持固定。

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · 安装：当前版本适用于 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1**。使用 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 时，请安装插件标签 `v0.1.1`。

在 DSH 插件管理器中安装以下 Git 来源：

```text
github:Rakanrkk/dsh-sidebar-scroll#main
```

使用 CLI 管理 Web profile 时：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:Rakanrkk/dsh-sidebar-scroll#main'
```

DSH Desktop 请使用应用自己的插件管理器，确保安装到桌面 profile。安装后刷新界面。仓库包含已构建的客户端，安装时无需执行构建脚本。

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · 使用效果：- Projects 列表随内容展开，与上方功能菜单共用滚动窗口。
- 绑定了 DSH section scroller 的工作区浏览器保留原生滚动接力；未绑定该接口的旧版工作区使用外层滚动，并保留外层滚动条。
- 滚动时关闭 Projects 会话菜单。
- 面板图标与固定操作、窄屏抽屉、键盘焦点和创建会话权限跟随当前官方侧栏。

Projects 适配使用 1.0.0-local.1 中的 `.pj-root` 和 `.pj-list` 选择器。修改了这些选择器的版本需要单独检查兼容性。

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · 停用与卸载：在插件管理器中停用或移除整个 **DSH 侧栏共用滚动 bundle**，然后刷新界面。管理器提示需要重启时，重启对应的 DSH 进程后生效。移除其组合补丁后恢复官方侧栏。只禁用 `sidebar-scroll` 运行条目时，bundle 补丁仍会关闭官方侧栏，可能使侧栏为空；此时重新启用该条目，或停用整个 bundle 即可恢复。

启用时，本插件替代 `ui-sidebar` 呈现行。同一时间只使用一个替代侧栏外壳的插件。升级 DSH 前请核对兼容性：本版本包含对应宿主版本的侧栏组件，因此限定为同一版本。

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · 开发：使用 Node.js 24.9.0 或更新版本：

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
npm run check
```

仓库保留已构建的 `lib/client.js`，供 Git 安装直接使用。CI 会检查重新构建后该文件是否一致。

执行 `npm run check:host` 可离线检查已安装的桌面运行时。Windows 下会查找默认的用户级安装位置；其他位置使用 `npm run check:host -- --asar /path/to/app.asar`。该检查在 DOM 测试环境中加载安装包里的 renderer、共享客户端模块和官方工作区组件，不修改 profile，并报告真实工作区是否消费 section-scroller hook 或使用外层滚动降级。

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · 开发：`npm run check:browser` 使用已有 Chromium 验证布局和滚动，可通过 `CHROME_PATH` 指定浏览器。有宿主安装包时使用实际插件 bundle 与宿主工作区 CSS；没有时使用实际 CSS、handoff 源码及布局 fixture。检查覆盖旧工作区、绑定内部滚动器的工作区和 Projects 形状的列表。CI 设置 `DSH_REQUIRE_BROWSER=1`，缺少浏览器会失败。真实 Projects 业务操作与完整 GUI 启停仍属于另外的集成检查。

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · 发布：推送与包版本一致的 `vX.Y.Z` 标签会复用 CI，检查构建、测试、版本信息，并用 [dsh-plugin-checker](https://github.com/bowenliang123/dsh-plugin-checker) 将打包文件安装到对应版本的 DSH。通过后，同一安装包用于 GitHub Release 和 npm。Actions 中也可手动运行 Release，指定已有标签重试；npm 已存在的版本必须与安装包的完整性校验一致。

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · 发布：npm 默认使用 [Trusted Publishing](https://docs.npmjs.com/trusted-publishers/)。首次发布需 npm 账号拥有 `@rakan` scope，并将可创建该包的凭据配置到仓库 Secret `NPM_TOKEN`；该路径发布的仍是 CI 已验证的安装包。包创建后，在包设置中配置 GitHub Actions：账号 `Rakanrkk`、仓库 `dsh-sidebar-scroll`、工作流 `release.yml`，Environment 留空，并允许直接 `npm publish`。删除 `NPM_TOKEN` 后使用 OIDC，首次成功发布需在新配置创建后的两天内完成。未完成账号侧配置时，GitHub Release 仍可独立发布，npm job 会报告失败。

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · 发布：每个 Release 同时提供版本化安装包和字节相同的 `dsh-sidebar-scroll.tgz`。已有资产会校验 SHA-256，不会覆盖。社区下载入口使用 `releases/latest/download/dsh-sidebar-scroll.tgz`，普通稳定版发布后即可更新下载内容，无需每次修改目录或提交 PR。预发布版本不更新稳定版市场登记。

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · 发布：社区网站登记在 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/blob/main/data/plugins/Rakanrkk__dsh-sidebar-scroll.yml)。`node scripts/update-market.mjs` 检查下载地址与描述；加 `--submit` 可使用已登录的 GitHub CLI 提交变更。登记没有变化时不开 PR，有待处理更新 PR 时会复用。功能或支持的 DSH 版本变化时，才可能需要修改登记。配置可写入本人 fork、提交上游 PR 的 `MARKET_TOKEN` 后可自动提交；未配置时保留草稿供下载。

已安装插件的更新检测与目录编辑分开：dsh-market 检查 npm 版本或用户选定的 GitHub 来源，显式固定的标签或安装包仍保持固定。社区网站收录不要求 npm；社区提供的 format-1 DSH 发现索引目前需要 npm 元数据及后续探测、构建。

@rakan/dsh-sidebar-scroll README · 许可与上游：MIT。侧栏呈现代码来自 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar 0.2.2-rc.1`，对应提交 [fcc0ad4](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/commit/fcc0ad462172522aaf5c93a7b2e01f6b9f0b0159)。上游版权声明保留在 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 中，内联依赖的许可见 [THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt)。

执行 `npm run check:host` 可离线检查已安装的桌面运行时。Windows 下会查找默认的用户级安装位置；其他位置使用 `npm run check:host -- --asar /path/to/app.asar`。该检查在 DOM 测试环境中加载安装包里的 renderer、共享客户端模块和官方工作区组件，不修改 profile，并报告真实工作区是否消费 section-scroller hook 或使用外层滚动降级。
